notes.title: Update Notes For Dec 23
notes.notes: Achievement Fix: Players no longer need to beat the game three times. Completing the first chapter on Hard difficulty now automatically unlocks the Normal and Easy achievements.

notes.title: Update notes for Dec 10
notes.notes: Small resolutions settings fix - sometimes the buttons to change resolution didn't work,

notes.title: Halloween Update is LIVE!
notes.notes:
[h1]Presenting a free content update:[/h1]

[list]
[*] 3 new levels based on the Autumn season
[*] 3 new boss fights
[*] 4 New weapons
[*] New enemy types
[*] New Puzzles
[*] New character skins
[*] Added achievements
[/list]
[h1]
Also fixed bugs:[/h1]

[list]
[*] Reworked settings menu
[*] Added UI sounds
[*] Added back button support for UI
[*] Fixed bomb-throwing bug where I won't throw correctly while running in the opposite direction
[*] Added an invisible wall on the train level so players wouldn't fall when running toward the front of the train
[/list]

notes.title: Steam Scream 3D
notes.notes:
Hello there!

The spookiest season is here once again! Just like last year, No More Snow is joining the festivities with a spooky discount.

notes.title: Summer Update is LIVE!
notes.notes:
[h3]Santa and Mrs. Claus just wanted a short, relaxing vacation under the summer sun. But shadows are never far away. When new troubles emerge, the duo, as always, handles them with serious firepower.[/h3]

[h3]Presenting a free content update:[/h3]

[list]
[*] 3 new levels
[*] 3 new boss fights
[*] New weapons
[*] New enemy types
[*] Puzzles
[*] New character skins
[*] Added Polish and Turkish language support
[/list]

[h3]Also fixed bugs:[/h3]

[list]
[*] Fixed situation where only one player dies but the level restarts
[*] Fixed enemy spawning near players at checkpoints
[*] Fixed Frost King boss damaging only player 1
[*] Fixed Blob Snowman toxic puddles damaging only player 1
[*] Fixed camera returning to player 1's dead body after player 2 dies
[*] Fixed bug where player is controllable but in a dead animation state
[*] Changed minigun sound
[*] Changed sniper gun behavior
[*] Fixed various other bugs
[/list]

[h3]Have a great summer, and stay tuned for the next updates![/h3]

notes.title: Update Notes for Mar 13
notes.notes: - Thanks to steam user lambic74, it has come to my attention that the previous bug fix didn't solve the issue of two controllers for all players. Therefore, I have reworked how the game detects the type of controller connected. Now, players should not encounter any problems when playing with two gamepads.

notes.title: Update Notes for Feb 11
notes.notes: - Fixed a bug with controller support. Now, each co-op player can use their own controller.

notes.title: Steam Scream: The Revenge is here!
notes.notes:
Hello there!

The spookiest season of them all is already here! Let’s celebrate it together in Steam Scream: The Revenge event! Play the No More Snow demo and look forward to new, exciting content coming soon!

notes.title: Steam Next Fest LIVESTREAM! Join me for live gameplay and commentary!
notes.notes:
Hey there, folks! 🎅

I'm excited to invite you to join me for a unique gaming session. In this livestream event, I'll be playing my very own game No More Snow, and I'll be right there with you, sharing all the insights that went into its creation. 

LIVESTREAM starts Oct 13, 7 p.m. Pacific.🗓️

Whether you're a fan of my game or simply curious about game development, this event is for you. You'll have the chance to ask me questions, hear about the behind-the-scenes process, and uncover a never-seen game level. 

So mark your calendar and join me. See you there! 🎄🪓
